The path here

My first internship was writing AI/ML documentation at Krypt, turning how senior engineers worked into references their engineering and QA teams adopted.

At Purdue Fort Wayne I studied computer science with minors in math and business, and spent a summer at Avyay making OCR models measurably better. On the side I built the things I wanted to exist: a real-time ASL translator that became two research papers, and a trading bot.

Now I'm at NYU Courant for my M.S. and interning at IBM, focused on ML systems that work in the real world, not just in a notebook.
